title: Web Essentials: favicon + iPhone home-screen icon
summary: A checklist Claude follows on every website it builds: a favicon, a proper iPhone Add-to-Home-Screen icon, and the right meta tags. Includes a script that turns any emoji into all the icons in one command.
how_to_use: Install it and it kicks in whenever you ask Claude to build a web page. Or run it yourself: python3 ~/.claude/skills/web-essentials/scripts/emoji_icon.py "🚀" --title "My Site"
requires: macOS (uses the Apple emoji font) and Python with Pillow (pip install pillow).
